title: Black Clover Season 2 Finally Debuts Asta’s Strongest Form After 5 Years – Watch
content:
It took five long years of waiting, but the newest episode of Black Clover Season 2 has finally brought Asta’s strongest form to anime after all this time. Black Clover Season 2 has picked up right from where the first season left off as Asta and the others are now in the midst of rematches against the Spade Kingdom’s Dark Triad . But while the other Magic Knights are currently in the other region, Asta needed to stay behind to work on his new power up some more.

Black Clover Season 2 saw a giant devil appear and attack the Clover Kingdom, this left those behind without much way to fight against it thanks to the immense difference in strength. Thankfully, it’s not long before Asta appears with a now semi-mastered version of his transformation, Devil Union, that he had been working with together with Liebe . You can check it out below as the anime really went all out to bring the moment to life with this official clip.

Asta’s Devil Union Form Debuts in Black Clover Season 2 Episode 3

Black Clover Season 3 Episode 3 picks up after a giant demon is seen attacking the Clover Kingdom. Nothing the Magic Knights there can do is strong enough to deal any real damage, and the Wizard King’s current weakened state means he couldn’t do much against it either. But thankfully, Asta soon appears and uses his newly acquired Devil Union form to defeat with some well placed strikes. This is the form that he had been working with Liebe to master in his training with Nacht.

Asta’s Devil Union is the form that fans of the Black Clover manga have been waiting to see animated ever since Asta began his training at the tail end of the anime’s first season back in 2021. Unfortunately, this form hasn’t really been kept a secret by the anime’s production team either. Not only has it been seen with pretty much every bit of promotional materials for the second season since it was announced, but it’s also been headlining the anime’s new opening for the season . So it’s great to see it in action already.

How Strong Is Asta’s Devil Union Form in Black Clover ?

Much like how Nacht has been able to fuse his powers with the four Devils that he’s contracted with, Asta and Liebe can now unite their own abilities through Devil Union. The strength of his anti-magic has increased as a result of this form, but the drawback for now is the fact that he only has access to it for five minutes at a time before it breaks (which is what happens in the episode itself). Even then it’s really an estimate as it’s clear that Asta doesn’t really keep too close of track of the time .

Even with all of that said, Asta’s Devil Union form is a cool design that the series is going to be showing off a lot more of now (as you can see in the newly released poster above) that the fights against the Dark Triad have begun once more. This form has been seen with the Dark Triad themselves as they use their own demons to increase their strength, and puts Asta on their level.

How are you liking Asta’s Devil Union form so far? What are you hoping to see in Black Clover Season 2 before it ends? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Officially Kicks Off English Dub With Crunchyroll Release
content:
The Apothecary Diaries has now returned for the start of its English dub release for Season 3, and it’s now available with Crunchyroll. The Apothecary Diaries was one of the major franchises that fans were excited to see return for more episodes as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule , and is currently a few episodes into its run. But for fans of the English dub release, they have unfortunately had to wait a bit longer before getting the chance to see the new season in action themselves.

Thankfully, the wait is finally over as The Apothecary Diaries has now kicked off the English dub release for its Season 3 return this Fall. After being previously confirmed to be a part of Crunchyroll’s English dub release schedule for the Fall 2026 slate , The Apothecary Diaries is now streaming the first episode of the new season with Crunchyroll with future episodes of the new season releasing on a weekly basis. With a returning English dub voice cast in tow, fans of the series are going to want to jump in.

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 English Dub Voice Cast & Release Schedule Revealed

Following the debut of the first episode on Friday, October 16th, Crunchyroll has confirmed that new episodes of The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 English dub will then be releasing on a weekly basis. With the Japanese language release only two episodes ahead thus far, it’s not going to be too wide of a gap between each version either. The voice cast has been revealed too and new additions to the series include Jad Saxton as the mysterious “White Lady,” who is going to be central to the core mystery that Maomao needs to get to the bottom of this season.

The returning English voice cast for The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 includes Emi Lo as Maomao, Kaiji Tang as Jinshi, Suzie Yeung as Shisui, Anne Yatco as Kyou-u, Nazeeh Tarsha as Guard, Wendy Powell as Madam, Oscar Seung as Ukyou, Seth Fuentes as Lihkau, Eli Farmer as Onsou, Caleb Yen as Lahan, Alex Mai as Emperor, Ricco Fajardo as Lakan, Reshel Mae as Lishu, Monica Rial as the Narrator, and more. Now is the perfect time to catch up with it all too.

What’s Going on With The Apothecary Diaries Season 3?

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has begun to spark a whole new mystery as not only is the region on the cusp of a famine with a mysterious horde of locusts seemingly making their way through the fields, there’s also a mysterious woman walking around the poorer sections with some kind of plan in mind. But all the while, Maomao has been looking at the whole picture to try and figure out what’s been going on this whole time. It’s only just gotten started, however.

The Apothecary Diaries has confirmed that Season 3 will be running for 24 episodes in total, with a single cour of 12 episodes planned for the Fall . The series will then be taking a few months off before returning for its second half sometime next April as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule. With a new movie releasing across theaters in Japan in between the two halves, it’s going to be a big year for fans of this franchises.

Are you excited to jump into the English dub for The Apothecary Diaries Season 3? What are you hoping to see in the new episodes? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Bleach Final Season Preview Reveals First Look & Synopsis for Final Episodes
content:
Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity is gearing up to return for the first of its final two episodes, and the first look images and story synopsis are now giving an idea of what fans can expect to see go down. Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War returned for its fourth and final season of episodes earlier this Summer, but unfortunately it had announced a surprise month long delay before the release of its final two episodes . But thankfully the wait is finally over.

With the penultimate episode of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity making its debut this week following its hiatus, the franchise has dropped the first look images for Episode 49. Teasing the final battle against Yhwach, the synopsis for the episode sets up the multi-regional fight with many characters involved. And this is a huge departure from how it all went down in Tite Kubo’s original Bleach manga version of the events.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 49 Preview Images Revealed

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity Episode 49 will be officially making its debut on Monday, October 19th at 8:30AM PT with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ . This will be the Japanese language audio version with English subtitles, and the English dubbed version of Episode 49 will be launching with Hulu on November 23rd at 8:30AM PT. As detailed by the anime’s official website, the penultimate episode of the series is titled “The Blade,” and picks up right after the cliffhanger as Yhwach invades all three major regions as part of his takeover.

“Transcending dimensions, Yhwach simultaneously appears in the Soul Society, the Human World, and Hueco Mundo, declaring his intention to reduce the world to nothingness and create a new world without the ‘fear of life’ or the ‘fear of death,’” the synopsis for the episode teases. “However, Ichigo, who rose from the depths of despair, and his allies, including the Soul Reapers and Arrancar, have not yet given up on this world. In each of the three realms, the final bloody battle against Yhwach begins.” Which is a total departure from the manga .

How Is Bleach ‘s Anime Ending Different From the Manga?

There are only two and a half chapters left from Tite Kubo’s original Bleach manga for the anime to adapt with these final episodes, and about 75% of those chapters are focused on the epilogue that takes place years after the fight . The final fight with Yhwach himself is only about ten or so pages, and didn’t see him fully invading all three worlds. The previously released trailer and these first look images also tease that other characters will be involved in fending off Yhwach, and that’s something that didn’t take place in the original. Which means the anime is making this the most expansive final fight yet.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has been making all sorts of welcome changes to the original way the final arc played out in the manga as Kubo has been working closely together with the production team to make it the most complete version of the story. If the anime is able to stick the landing with these changes in the final two episodes, then this is going to be one of the most memorable finales yet.

What are you hoping to see in Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War ‘s final two episodes? How have you liked the final season overall? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Love Live! Hasunosora Anime Reveals Key Visual, Additional Voice Cast
content:
The previously announced Love Live! Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club anime revealed a new key visual on Sunday. It is slated to premiere in January 2027. Three additional voice cast members were also revealed:

• Julia Hoshimiya as Maika Kinjo

• Kana Asahi as Aoi Reisawa

• Kanae Yuasa as Mion Shinowa

The main cast of Hasunosura consists of:

• Nozomi Nirei as Kaho Hinoshita

• Kokona Nonaka as Sayaka Murano

• Kanna Kan as Rurino Osawa

• Hina Sakurai as Ginko Momose

• Fuka Hayama as Kosuzu Kachimachi

• Rin Kurusu as Hime Anyoji

• Miu Miyake as Ceras Yanagida Lilienfeld

• Amane Shindo as Izumi Katsuragi

• Niina Hanamiya as Kozue Otomune (graduated)

• Kona Tsukine as Megumi Fujishima (graduated)

• Kotoko Sasaki as Tsuzuri Yugiri (graduated)

The artist photo of the group has also been updated:

The Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club is part of the Link! Like! Love Live! project, which is centered around a smartphone application that launched on April 15, 2023. The members are introduced and developed within the app, which includes interactive storytelling, live 3D performances, and social media-style engagement with the idols. They made their musical debut with the song “Dream Believers,” which served as their first group single. Source: Official X (formerly Twitter) ©︎ Project Love Live! Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club

title: Manga 'NullMeta' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
Production company Aniplex opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Kokamumo 's NullMeta manga on Sunday, revealing the main staff and a teaser visual (pictured).

Animation studio Soigne , known for Kamiina Botan, Yoeru Sugata wa Yuri no Hana ( Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk ) and Mono , is producing the anime, set to premiere in 2027.

Staff Director: Kai Ikarashi ( Tengoku Daimakyou episode director) Series Composition: Tatsuya Takahashi ( Class no Daikirai na Joshi to Kekkon suru Koto ni Natta. ) Character Design: Shin Ogasawara ( Ousama Ranking animation director)

Ikarashi is also directing the upcoming Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime series, which is set to premiere on October 20.

Kokamumo began serializing the 4-koma comedy manga in Manga Time Kirara MAX magazine in December 2019. Houbunsha published the sixth volume on January 27.

The manga originated from web comics posted on the author's Tumblr and Pixiv accounts in April 2018, followed by a self-published serialization on Niconico Seiga in September 2018. The web version and the magazine serialization feature some differences in their settings and chronology.

Synopsis Kurumi is an android who isn’t very bright. Her guardian Chiaki is a bit of a lunatic, and the two of them go through high school alongside Sakina and Shiyuki. Sakina is cool and composed until something sets her off laughing, which doesn’t take much. Shiyuki is the only sane one(?), and the question mark is doing a lot of work there.

Their days are mostly nothing in particular. They upgrade Kurumi, fuss over her like a pet, and chat about whatever comes up.

title: Kokamumo's Null-Meta Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
Aniplex announced on Sunday that Kokamumo 's Null-Meta manga is getting a television anime adaptation.

Aniplex had teased the announcement with a video on Friday that had featured the letters "NLMT."

Kai Ikarashi ( Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 ) is directing the anime at the studio Soigne ( mono , Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk ). Tatsuya Takahashi ( Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon , The IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls ) is in charge of the series scripts, and Shin Ogasawara IPokémon: Twilight Wings) is designing the characters.

The slice-of-life manga centers on the really dumb android Kurumi, her guardian Chiaki who is a little crazy, the calm and collected Sakina who is easily amused, and the only sane(?) one of the bunch, Shiyuki. The manga follows their high school life as they remodel Kurumi and dote on her, and talk about nothing in particular.

Kokamumo launched the four-panel manga in Houbunsha 's Manga Time Kirara Max magazine in March 2020. Houbunsha published the sixth compiled volume on January 27.

title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 49 Preview, Staff, and Synopsis Revealed
content:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 9 (Episode 49 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25, before delaying the final two episodes to improve quality . It is set to run for 10 episodes, with the series recently revealing the last trailer .

The ninth episode is titled “XXX,” and it will premiere on Saturday, October 17. You can see the synopsis and preview images below.

Transcending dimensions, Yhwach appears simultaneously in the Seireitei, the World of the Living, and Hueco Mundo. He declares his intention to reduce the world to nothingness and create a new world free from both the “fear of life” and the “fear of death.” However, Ichigo, who has risen from the depths of despair, and his allies, including the Soul Reapers and Arrancars, have not yet given up on this world. Across all three realms, the final, bloody battle against Yhwach begins.

ALSO READ: Interview: Ichigo Voice Actors Masakazu Morita and Johnny Yong Bosch Talk BLEACH BLEACH JET Artbook and Ryogo Narita’s School Life Novel Return, Fan Vote and 2027 Exhibition Announced

BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 49 Staff:

• Script: Tomohisa Taguchi

• Storyboard: Satoshi Sakai, Tomohisa Taguchi

• Episode Director: Chen Dali, Shintaro Matsui, Tomohisa Taguchi

• Chief Animation Director: Yukio Hasegawa

• Animation Directors: Saeko Ozawa, Cindy H. Yamauchi, Mari Tominaga

You can also watch the trailer for the final two episodes below.

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.

On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High revealed its protagonists in a new trailer, with the game featuring original character designs by Tite Kubo.

Episode Director: Chen Dali, Shintaro Matsui, Tomohisa Taguchi
Chief Animation Director: Yukio Hasegawa
Animation Directors: Saeko Ozawa, Cindy H. Yamauchi, Mari Tominaga
You can also watch the trailer for the final two episodes below.

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.
On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High revealed its protagonists in a new trailer, with the game featuring original character designs by Tite Kubo.

title: Arc System Works Opens New Studio Takumi on November 2
content:
The company added that the new studio is a "strategic cornerstone for going beyond existing conventional game development frameworks and delivering an overwhelming sense of 'ultimate excitement' to players around the world." Additionally, the company envisions the studio as a collaboration hub with a widespread global reach. The company also announced that it is expanding its recruitment of creators with the opening of the new studio.

PlayStation Studios , Arc System Works , and Marvel Games launched the Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls 4v4 tag team fighter game for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store on August 6 (August 7 in Japan).

Arc System Works also recently released the Donutal game on PC via Steam on September 3 (September 4 in Japan).

Arc System Works also announced on October 10 the PlayStation 5 release for its Blazblue: CentralFiction fighting game.

The company's Guilty Gear Strive fighting game inspired a television anime adaptation titled Guilty Gear Strive: Dual Rulers , which debuted in April 2025.

title: UK Blu-rays of Clevatess and Kaiju Mission No. 8 Film Will Be Released on Monday
content:
The story begins with Alicia — who has aspired to be a brave hero since she was little — after she has been chosen by the king to be one of 13 heroes for a quest. Wielding legendary swords, the heroes set out to subjugate the lord of magical beasts, Clevatess . However, these very heroes might bring about the realm's deadliest catastrophe that would wipe out all humanity. The world's last remaining hope lies in a baby entrusted to the lord of magical beasts.

Kiyotaka Taguchi (kaiju designer for SSSS.Dynazenon film) directed the anime at Lay-duce . Keigo Koyanagi ( Brave Bang Bravern! , The Rising of The Shield Hero ) was in charge of series scripts, Souichirou Sako ( Buddy Daddies , Magi: Adventure of Sinbad ) designed the characters, and Nobuaki Nobusawa ( Mr. Villain's Day Off , Police in a Pod , Steins;Gate 0 ) composied the music.

Iwahara ( Darker than Black character designer, King of Thorn manga creator) launched the manga on the LINE Manga app in August 2020. Kadokawa started serializing the manga on its Comic Alive+ website in April 2024.

" Kaiju No. 8: Mission Recon is a 2025 recap film that condenses the events of the anime's first season. In a Kaiju-filled Japan, Kafka Hibino works in monster disposal. After reuniting with childhood friend Mina Ashiro, a rising star in the anti-Kaiju Defense Force, he pursues his abandoned dream until he transforms into “ Kaiju No. 8 .”

The first season of Kaiju No. 8 premiered on TV Tokyo on April 13, 2024 and aired for 12 episodes. Shigeyuki Miya ( Onihei ) and Tomomi Kamiya directed the anime. Ichirō Ōkouchi ( Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion ) handled the series composition and screenplay. Tetsuya Nishio ( Naruto ) was the character designer and chief animation director. Mahiro Maeda ( Shin Godzilla ) designed the monsters. Shinji Kimura ( Tekkonkinkreet ) was the art director. Yūta Bandō ( BELLE ) composed the music.

Production I.G ( Ghost in the Shell ) handled animation production, and Studio Khara ( Rebuild of Evangelion ) was in charge of kaiju designs and artworks.

Muse India describes the anime:

"Kenzaburo Tondabayashi, a 52-year-old diligent public employee, died after a traffic incident… Or that was what's supposed to happen. When he wakes up, he finds himself reincarnated as a character from the world of the Otome game that his daughter loves, "Magical Academy Love & Beast". He is reincarnated as Grace Auvergne, the villainess who obstructs the love life of the game's protagonist, Anna Doll. And so, Grace Kenzaburo tries to act like a villainess just like how the original Grace was. However, due to his life experience, he views Anna through the eyes of a parent and gives her advice. Along with his "Elegant Cheat" which translates his plebeian manner into something elegant, he inadvertently raises his popularity and raises the flags of the capture targets. The weapon you need to survive in another world is not swords or magic, but the Old Man Skill that one has cultivated through living in society!"

The manga centers on Tsukasa, a normal salaryman who is attacked one night by demons, and is saved by a genius kunoichi named Shizuri. In her off time though, Shizuri is a lazy otaku NEET. Tsukasa and Shizuri end up living together, with Tsukasa using his homemaking skills to pamper Shizuri as she continues to serve as his bodyguard.

Hisashi Saitō ( Bamboo Blade , Haganai , Heaven's Lost Property ) directed the anime at Quad . Takashi Aoshima ( Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out! , The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You ) oversaw the series scripts, Masahiko Suzuki ( Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs ) designed the characters, and CMJK (theme songs for Eyeshield 21 , Puzzle & Dragons X ) composed the music. REAL AKIBA BOYZ loves Shōko Nakagawa , a group consisting of Nakagawa and the b-boy dance unit REAL AKIBA BOYZ , performed the opening theme song "Neet In Jam🍓."

"Jiraiya's fate weighs heavily on Naruto 's young heart, but his sorrow turns to determination as he tries to solve Jiraiya's mysterious message. Then the unthinkable happens - the godlike Pain passes through the Leaf's defences and attacks the village directly!"
author: ANN

title: Kaiju Decode: The Ring of Aidara Anime Reveals Teaser Trailer, 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for Tsuburaya Productions and Toei Animation 's Kaiju Decode CG anime project revealed a teaser trailer, a new teaser visual, and the 2027 debut for Kaiju Decode: The Ring of Aidara ( Kaiju Decode: Aidara no Yubiwa ), on Sunday.

• Aya Yamane as Maru, a boy from the City

• Karin Takahashi as Coco, a girl of the Aidara tribe who lives in the dangerous Zone where beasts are found

The new anime takes place in Sakai in Osaka prefecture. Katsuie Shibata ( Hitchhiker's Guide to the Isekai ) is writing the screenplay. Masayuki Gotou ( SSSS.Dynazenon ) is designing the monsters. Hollywood CG art director Sei Nakashima ( Mewtwo Strikes Back Evolution end credits illustrations, Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone concept artist) is the character designer for Maru. Masatsugu Saitō ( Cyborg 009 Call of Justice ) is the designer for Coco. JNTHED ( Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury ) illustrated the teaser visual (pictured right).

The project's theme is "a story about kaiju and girls," and the studios are aiming the project at a worldwide audience.

A full anime short for Kaiju Decode streamed in December 2021 on the Tsuburaya Imagination website. The companies also released a VR anime short titled Kaiju Decode : First Contact on the same day for Oculus Quest. Both anime are listed as the "first part" of the overall project.

S/N directed the anime at Arect . Tetsuya Yamada wrote the script, and Tadahiko Inoue composed the music. The anime stars Nobunaga Shimazaki as Rei, Marika Kōno as Miru, Mayumi Shintani as Zora, and Aya Yamane as Real Rei.

The producers for the project include Kōichi Noguchi and Masahiro Onda . Noguchi is the producer of such anime as Expelled from Paradise and KADO - The Right Answer , while Onda is a veteran Tsuburaya Productions producer for such projects as Ultraman Zero: The Revenge of Belial , as well as an executive producer on the SSSS.Gridman anime series. Sei Nakashima is the character designer.
author: ANN
